```{ojs}
// ── Load data from the simulated branch ──
data = await fetch("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/copernicus-land/clms-cdse-migration-data/feat/simulated-data/migration_data.json")
  .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(String(r.status)); return r.json() })
  .catch(e => { console.error("Failed to load data", e); return {groups:[], portfolio:{}, cdse:{}, summary:{}} })
groups = data.groups
summary = data.summary
portfolio = data.portfolio
cdse = data.cdse
lastUpdated = data.scraped_at.slice(0,10)

// ── OData deltas from the simulated data ──
odataDelta = data.odata_delta || 0
odataWeekly = data.weekly_delta || 0
odataDailyAvg = data.odata_daily_avg || 0

// ── Filter groups ──
componentOf = d => {
  if (d.datasets?.length > 0) return d.datasets[0].component
  return d.portfolio?.[0]?.component || ""
}
groupHasComponent = (g, comp) => {
  if (g.datasets?.some(d => d.component === comp)) return true
  if (g.portfolio?.some(d => d.component === comp)) return true
  return false
}
filtered = groups.filter(d => {
  let matches = false
  for (const comp of activeComponents) {
    if (groupHasComponent(d, comp)) { matches = true; break }
  }
  if (!matches) return false
  if (searchTerm && !d.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())) return false
  return true
})

// ── Aggregate by category ──
categories = [...new Set(filtered.map(d => d.category).filter(Boolean))].sort()

filteredTotals = ({
  datasets: d3.sum(filtered, d => d.total),
  groups: filtered.length
})
catStats = categories.map(cat => {
  const g = filtered.filter(d => d.category === cat)
  return {
    name: cat,
    groups: g,
    total: d3.sum(g, d => d.total),
    on_cdse: d3.sum(g, d => d.on_cdse),
    pct: Math.round(d3.sum(g, d => d.on_cdse) / Math.max(d3.sum(g, d => d.total), 1) * 100),
    s3: d3.sum(g, d => d.s3),
    stac: d3.sum(g, d => d.stac),
    openeo: d3.sum(g, d => d.openeo),
    shub: d3.sum(g, d => d.shub),
  }
})

// ── Helpers ──
badge = (val, total) => {
  if (val === 0 && total === 0) return htl.html`<span style="background:#888;color:#fff;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:bold">—</span>`
  const pct = Math.min(val / Math.max(total, 1), 1)
  const color = pct >= 1 ? "#00aa00" : pct >= 0.75 ? "#66cc00" : pct >= 0.5 ? "#ffcc00" : pct >= 0.25 ? "#ff8800" : "#ff0000"
  return htl.html`<span style="background:${color};color:#fff;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:bold">${val}</span>`
}

pctBar = (pct) => {
  const capped = Math.min(pct, 100)
  const filled = "█".repeat(Math.floor(capped / 5))
  const empty = "░".repeat(Math.max(0, 20 - Math.floor(capped / 5)))
  const color = pct >= 100 ? "#00aa00" : pct >= 75 ? "#66cc00" : pct >= 50 ? "#ffcc00" : pct >= 25 ? "#ff8800" : "#ff0000"
  return htl.html`<span style="color:${color};font-weight:bold">${pct}%</span> <span style="color:#888">${filled}${empty}</span>`
}

check = (on) => on
  ? htl.html`<span style="color:#00aa00;font-weight:bold">✓</span>`
  : htl.html`<span style="color:#ccc">✗</span>`

// ── Deltas vs previous run ──
prevByName = Object.fromEntries((data.previous?.groups || []).map(g => [g.name, g]))
changes = (data.previous?.groups?.length ? groups : []).map(g => {
  const old = prevByName[g.name] || {}
  const oldIds = new Set(old.cdse_dataset_ids || [])
  const oldStac = new Set(old.stac_ids || [])
  const oldOeo = new Set(old.openeo_ids || [])
  const curIds = (g.datasets || []).map(d => d.id)
  const dS3 = g.s3 - (old.s3 || 0)
  const dStac = g.stac - (old.stac || 0)
  const dOeo = g.openeo - (old.openeo || 0)
  return {
    name: g.name,
    s3: dS3, stac: dStac, openeo: dOeo,
    newly_on_cdse: g.on_cdse > 0 && !(old.on_cdse > 0),
    new_s3: dS3 > 0 ? curIds.filter(id => !oldIds.has(id)) : [],
    new_stac: dStac > 0 ? curIds.filter(id => !oldStac.has(id)) : [],
    new_openeo: dOeo > 0 ? curIds.filter(id => !oldOeo.has(id)) : [],
  }
}).filter(d => d.s3 !== 0 || d.stac !== 0 || d.openeo !== 0)
newGroups = changes.filter(d => d.newly_on_cdse)
positiveChanges = changes.filter(d => d.s3 > 0 && !d.newly_on_cdse)
lastWeek = changes.length > 0 ? "since " + (data.previous?.scraped_at || data.scraped_at).slice(0,10) : ""

// ── Expand/collapse state ──
expandedCategories = new Set()
expandedGroups = new Set()

// ── Toggle functions ──
toggleScript = {
  window.toggleCategory = function(catName) {
    const key = catName.replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
    const groupRows = document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-category="' + key + '"]:not([data-group])');
    const isExpanded = groupRows.length > 0 && groupRows[0].style.display !== 'none';
    groupRows.forEach(function(r) { r.style.display = isExpanded ? 'none' : ''; });
    if (isExpanded) {
      document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-category="' + key + '"][data-group]').forEach(function(r) { r.style.display = 'none'; });
      document.querySelectorAll('span[data-group-arrow^="' + key + '::"]').forEach(function(a) { a.textContent = '▶'; });
      expandedCategories.delete(catName);
      [...expandedGroups].filter(k => k.startsWith(catName + '::')).forEach(k => expandedGroups.delete(k));
    } else {
      expandedCategories.add(catName);
    }
    const arrow = document.querySelector('span[data-arrow="' + key + '"]');
    if (arrow) arrow.textContent = isExpanded ? '▶' : '▼';
  }
  window.toggleGroup = function(groupKey) {
    const key = groupKey.replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
    const rows = document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-group="' + key + '"]');
    const isExpanded = rows.length > 0 && rows[0].style.display !== 'none';
    rows.forEach(function(r) { r.style.display = isExpanded ? 'none' : ''; });
    if (isExpanded) expandedGroups.delete(groupKey);
    else expandedGroups.add(groupKey);
    const arrow = document.querySelector('span[data-group-arrow="' + key + '"]');
    if (arrow) arrow.textContent = isExpanded ? '▶' : '▼';
  }
}
```

## Status Overview

The CLMS portfolio is composed of **{ojs} portfolio.total_datasets** datasets. Of these, the following are available on the CDSE:

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| CLMS in S3 | {ojs} cdse.total_dataset_ids dataset IDs |
| CLMS via OData | {ojs} cdse.total_products_odata.toLocaleString() files |
| CLMS via STAC | {ojs} cdse.total_stac_collections collections |
| CLMS via OpenEO | {ojs} cdse.total_openeo_collections collections |

## CLMS Products on CDSE

This table shows the full CLMS portfolio with their migration status to the CDSE.

```{ojs}
// Toggle-button component filter
viewof activeComponents = {
  const allComponents = [...new Set(groups.map(d => componentOf(d)).filter(Boolean))].sort()
  const active = new Set(allComponents)

  const container = document.createElement("div")
  container.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px";

  function render() {
    container.innerHTML = "";
    allComponents.forEach(comp => {
      const isActive = active.has(comp);
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.type = "button";
      btn.textContent = comp;
      btn.style.cssText = `padding:6px 14px;border-radius:16px;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.85em;border:1px solid ${isActive ? "#0d6efd" : "#ccc"};background:${isActive ? "#0d6efd" : "#f5f5f5"};color:${isActive ? "#fff" : "#555"}`;
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (active.has(comp)) active.delete(comp); else active.add(comp);
        render();
        activeComponents.value = active;
        activeComponents.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
      });
      container.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }
  render();
  return container;
}

// Search
viewof searchTerm = html`<input type="text" placeholder="🔍 Search product groups..." style="width:100%;padding:8px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:0.9em">`

// Build table
productGroupsTable = {
  const COLS = 8;
  const colWidths = ["12.5%", "12.5%", "12.5%", "12.5%", "12.5%", "12.5%", "12.5%", "12.5%"];

  function makeCell(tag, html, opts = {}) {
    const el = document.createElement(tag);
    if (html instanceof Node) el.appendChild(html);
    else el.innerHTML = html;
    el.style.padding = opts.padding ?? "6px";
    el.style.whiteSpace = "nowrap";
    el.style.overflow = "hidden";
    el.style.textOverflow = "ellipsis";
    if (opts.center) el.style.textAlign = "center";
    if (opts.bold) el.style.fontWeight = "bold";
    if (opts.title) el.title = opts.title;
    return el;
  }

  const table = document.createElement("table");
  table.style.cssText = "width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:0.8em;table-layout:fixed;display:table";

  const colgroup = document.createElement("colgroup");
  colWidths.forEach(w => {
    const col = document.createElement("col");
    col.style.width = w;
    colgroup.appendChild(col);
  });
  table.appendChild(colgroup);

  // Header
  const thead = document.createElement("thead");
  const headerRow = document.createElement("tr");
  ["Category / Group", "Total", "CDSE", "S3", "STAC", "OpenEO", "S.Hub", "Progress"].forEach(h => {
    const th = document.createElement("th");
    th.textContent = h;
    th.style.cssText = "background:#f1f3f5;padding:8px 6px;text-align:center;font-weight:600;border-bottom:2px solid #dee2e6;white-space:nowrap";
    headerRow.appendChild(th);
  });
  thead.appendChild(headerRow);
  table.appendChild(thead);

  const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");

  // Category rows
  catStats.forEach(cat => {
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    tr.style.cssText = "background:#f8f9fa;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600";
    tr.addEventListener("click", () => window.toggleCategory(cat.name));

    const nameCell = makeCell("td", `<span data-arrow="${cat.name}">▶</span> ${cat.name}`, {title: cat.name});
    tr.appendChild(nameCell);
    tr.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(cat.total), {center: true}));
    tr.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(cat.on_cdse), {center: true}));
    tr.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(cat.s3), {center: true}));
    tr.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(cat.stac), {center: true}));
    tr.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(cat.openeo), {center: true}));
    tr.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(cat.shub), {center: true}));
    tr.appendChild(makeCell("td", pctBar(cat.pct), {center: true}));
    tbody.appendChild(tr);

    // Group rows
    cat.groups.forEach(g => {
      const gtr = document.createElement("tr");
      gtr.dataset.category = cat.name;
      gtr.style.display = "none";

      const gS3 = g.s3 || 0;
      const gTotal = Math.max(g.total, gS3);
      const gPct = Math.round(gS3 / Math.max(gTotal, 1) * 100);

      const gNameCell = makeCell("td", `<a href="${g.url || '#'}" target="_blank" style="color:#333;text-decoration:none">${g.name}</a>`, {padding: "6px 6px 6px 24px"});
      gtr.appendChild(gNameCell);
      gtr.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(g.total), {center: true}));
      gtr.appendChild(makeCell("td", badge(g.on_cdse || 0, g.total), {center: true}));
      gtr.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(gS3), {center: true}));
      gtr.appendChild(makeCell("td", badge(g.stac || 0, gTotal), {center: true}));
      gtr.appendChild(makeCell("td", badge(g.openeo || 0, gTotal), {center: true}));
      gtr.appendChild(makeCell("td", badge(g.shub || 0, gTotal), {center: true}));
      gtr.appendChild(makeCell("td", pctBar(gPct), {center: true}));
      tbody.appendChild(gtr);
    });
  });

  // Summary row
  const allCatStats = catStats.reduce((acc, cat) => ({
    total: (acc.total || 0) + cat.total,
    on_cdse: (acc.on_cdse || 0) + cat.on_cdse,
    s3: (acc.s3 || 0) + cat.s3,
    stac: (acc.stac || 0) + cat.stac,
    openeo: (acc.openeo || 0) + cat.openeo,
    shub: (acc.shub || 0) + cat.shub,
  }), {});
  const allPct = Math.round(100 * (allCatStats.s3 || 0) / Math.max(allCatStats.total || 0, 1));

  const sumRow = document.createElement("tr");
  sumRow.style.cssText = "background:#e0e0e0;border-top:2px solid #999;font-weight:bold";
  const sumName = makeCell("td", "Total", {bold: true});
  sumName.style.fontStyle = "italic";
  sumRow.appendChild(sumName);
  sumRow.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(allCatStats.total), {center: true, bold: true}));
  sumRow.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(allCatStats.on_cdse), {center: true, bold: true}));
  sumRow.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(allCatStats.s3), {center: true, bold: true}));
  sumRow.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(allCatStats.stac), {center: true, bold: true}));
  sumRow.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(allCatStats.openeo), {center: true, bold: true}));
  sumRow.appendChild(makeCell("td", String(allCatStats.shub), {center: true, bold: true}));
  sumRow.appendChild(makeCell("td", pctBar(allPct), {center: true, bold: true}));
  tbody.appendChild(sumRow);

  table.appendChild(tbody);
  return table;
}
```

## Services

| Service | Endpoint |
|---|---|
| CDSE CSV Catalogue | [`csv.dataspace.copernicus.eu/CLMS/`](https://csv.dataspace.copernicus.eu/CLMS/) |
| CDSE OData API | [`catalogue.dataspace.copernicus.eu/odata/v1/Products`](https://catalogue.dataspace.copernicus.eu/odata/v1/Products?$filter=Collection/Name%20eq%20%27CLMS%27&$count=true&$top=1) |
| CDSE STAC API | [`stac.dataspace.copernicus.eu/v1/collections`](https://stac.dataspace.copernicus.eu/v1/collections?limit=500) |
| CDSE OpenEO API | [`openeo.dataspace.copernicus.eu/openeo/1.2/collections`](https://openeo.dataspace.copernicus.eu/openeo/1.2/collections) |

## Methodology

Data is collected from the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE) APIs and cross-referenced with the CLMS portfolio on the [Land Portal](https://land.copernicus.eu). Each CDSE dataset ID is mapped to a Land Portal product group. Service counts (S3, STAC, OpenEO, S.Hub) are collected per dataset ID. The OData count tracks total CLMS product files on CDSE storage.

This dashboard uses **simulated data** covering a 14-day timeline (21 July – 3 August 2026) for testing purposes.
